assumptions.reason: JS is the default scripting language; PYTHON is also supported.

blockers.message: SCRIPT_ACCUMULATOR language is required. Which scripting language? ('JS' or 'PYTHON')
SCRIPT_ACCUMULATOR source code is required. Provide the accumulation script (maintains running state per group key).
SCRIPT_ACCUMULATOR groupFields is required. Which fields define the accumulation groups? (e.g. ["accountNumber"])
SCRIPT_ACCUMULATOR schemaId is required. Which output schema should the accumulated events conform to? (get the ID from the Schema Registry)
